import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'

const projectRoot = new URL('../../../', import.meta.url)
const read = (path) => readFileSync(new URL(path, projectRoot), 'utf8')
const registration = read('src/views/register/index.vue')
const login = read('src/views/login.vue')
const userStore = read('src/store/modules/user.js')

const goToLogin = registration.match(/goToLogin\s*\(\)\s*\{([\s\S]*?)\n\s*\},/)
assert.ok(goToLogin, 'registration must keep a credential-dialog login action')
assert.match(goToLogin[1], /SET_TEMP_LOGIN_CREDENTIALS/, 'registration must pass credentials through the in-memory user store')
assert.match(goToLogin[1], /userName:\s*this\.credentials\.userName/, 'registration must hand off the generated username')
assert.match(goToLogin[1], /password:\s*this\.credentials\.password/, 'registration must hand off the generated password')

const routeQuery = goToLogin[1].match(/query:\s*\{([^}]*)\}/)
assert.ok(routeQuery, 'login navigation must carry the temporary-account marker')
assert.match(routeQuery[1], /tempAccount:\s*['"]1['"]/, 'login navigation must mark a temporary account')
assert.doesNotMatch(routeQuery[1], /userName|username|password|credentials/i, 'login credentials must never appear in route query parameters')
assert.doesNotMatch(goToLogin[1], /localStorage|sessionStorage/, 'credential handoff must not persist credentials in browser storage')

assert.match(userStore, /tempLoginCredentials:\s*null/, 'user store must initialize a transient credential slot')
assert.match(userStore, /SET_TEMP_LOGIN_CREDENTIALS\s*\(\s*state\s*,\s*credentials\s*\)\s*\{\s*state\.tempLoginCredentials\s*=\s*credentials\s*\}/s, 'user store must keep the handoff in memory')
assert.match(login, /tempLoginCredentials/, 'login must consume the in-memory temporary credentials')
assert.match(login, /loginForm\.username\s*=\s*\w+\.userName/, 'login must prefill the generated username')
assert.match(login, /loginForm\.password\s*=\s*\w+\.password/, 'login must prefill the generated password')
assert.match(login, /SET_TEMP_LOGIN_CREDENTIALS[\s\S]{0,80}null/, 'login must clear the in-memory handoff after consumption')
assert.doesNotMatch(login, /localStorage|sessionStorage/, 'login must not persist the handed-off credentials')

console.log('temporary credential handoff checks passed')
